messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx and generation tail latencies on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Pager: lina. Observed: KV prefix cache misses + genqueue backlog. Paging oncall and creating bridge. <https://pd.example/alert/1807777|pager-link> :rotating_light:

lina: on it — joining bridge. grabbing genqueue and cache metrics.

raj: seeing eviction spike in prefix-cache (host-level). genqueue backlog ~1.2k, token latency tails >1s. I think flushing the prefix cache on a canary subset should reduce misses. Will prepare a safe rollout.

maya: drafting initial statuspage copy below, tagging legal/ops. @sam @dave pinged.

maya: ```
Initial status (Investigating) — We are investigating increased error rates and higher than normal latency for text generation requests in US-West (us-west-2). Some requests may fail with 5xx or take longer to complete.
Impact: A subset of hosted API customers in US-West may observe failed or slow text generation.
Mitigation in progress: On-call engineering is performing a targeted cache refresh and rolling host updates to reduce cache misses and genqueue backlog.
Next update: in ~15 minutes or sooner with material changes.
```

sam: quick read — add line confirming no customer data exposure and we should avoid claiming full resolution until monitoring stable. otherwise good. :white_check_mark:

dave: also add that we’ve enabled fallback routing to smaller model variant to keep requests served while we mitigate. note the config change id if we make one.

lina: started canary cache flush on 3 hosts at 1807777120. bridge: https://zoom.example/bridge/1807777. Early telemetry: 5xx rate in canary down ~60%.

raj: can confirm — canary kv miss rate dropped, genqueue backlog on those hosts reduced to ~150. Planning to roll to remaining hosts in batches of 5 every 2 minutes.

maya: preparing to publish initial status now. Publishing cadence: publish initial Investigating, then updates at 15m intervals or on milestone (canary success, full rollout, resolved). I'll ping @pagebot to publish once I paste final copy. :memo:

maya: PUBLISH NOW — state=Investigating. Posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-1807777.

pagebot: Status page post created: INC-1807777 (Investigating) — https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-1807777 :rocket:

lina: rolling cache flush into remaining host batches starting 1807777235. watching error rate and latency.

raj: full rollout complete at 1807777330. overall 5xx count dropped to baseline and median generation latency back to normal. No customer data exposure. Config bump: prefix-cache.retention=1.2.3.

maya: drafting resolved notice. Proposed text: ```
Resolved — We completed a targeted prefix-cache refresh and host rollout to address elevated cache misses causing increased error rates and latency for text generation in US‑West. The underlying issue was an eviction storm after a recent model shard rebalancing. Services have returned to normal and we will continue monitoring. No customer data was exposed. If you continue to see issues, please contact support or reopen the incident.
```

sam: approved resolved copy. good to publish once monitoring stable for 10m. :thumbsup:

maya: publishing resolved now. state=Resolved. https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-1807777 — resolved at 1807777405. Monitoring for 30m.

pagebot: Status update published: INC-1807777 (Resolved). Notify: customers subscribed to US-West incidents.

dave: thanks team. postmortem follow-up: schedule RCA and mitigation ticket to avoid eviction storms (auto-extend retention or smoother rebalance).

lina: filing follow-up ticket and assigning to eng-runtime. Closing bridge. :white_check_mark:
